         gzhan lugs dgag pa ni  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3820">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3820">'dul 'dzin <expan>la sogs pa</expan></rs></note> na re brtan pa blo'i nus pa mtha' thug pa thob pa'i don du dkar po'i chos rim sgom mo zhes pa ltar na nyan rang chen po pa'i sbyor ba <lb n="27b4"/> 'dir smos mthar gyis sbyor du thal| brtan pa blo'i nus pa mtha' thug myang 'das gnyis thob pa'i don du dkar chos so bdun rim bsgom yod pa'i phyir| 'dod pa la khyab byed mkhyen gsum sbyor ba med par khyab bya mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yod par 'gal lo || </seg></TEI>
